description: This Java class implements a command strategy for adjusting a loan charge using external identifiers. It handles HTTP batch requests, extracts relevant URL parameters, invokes the loan charges API resource to perform the adjustment, and constructs the batch response accordingly.

classes.name: AdjustChargeByChargeExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy for adjusting loan charges via external IDs, managing batch request execution, and interfacing with the LoanChargesApiResource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a batch request to adjust a loan charge identified by external IDs by calling the LoanChargesApiResource and returning a batch response with the result.
